lessons.future_rule: Do not flatten a CAD or STIR receive on a sub-5bp implied backup from oil/Iran while cash policy is unchanged and the cash-implied hike gap remains wide; require a cash-rate shift, an explicit reaction-function change, or express the view in a lower oil-beta curve/RV.
lessons.text: A carry receive is invalidated by a change in cash policy or by a large, persistent re-pricing of the path, not by a small backup in implieds that is the mechanical beta of a headline already known at entry.
